reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest development update on Provincia! We've revamped the movement mechanics to enhance your colony battles. Now, soldiers will turn and march in a more realistic manner, eliminating the teleportation effect that disrupted gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

posts: Exciting changes are coming to Provincia! Our latest update focuses on realistic movement mechanics for your soldiers. No more teleporting; just smooth, strategic marching. steam.title: New Update: Improved Soldier Movement Mechanics
steam.body: We're pleased to announce a significant update to Provincia that focuses on enhancing the movement mechanics of your soldiers. No more teleportation during battles! Soldiers will now turn and march realistically, ensuring a smoother and more strategic gameplay experience. Read more about the changes here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
